pet_notes: A tiny friendly archivist dragon inspired by a thoughtful software builder and broad media enthusiast. Compact charcoal-indigo body, warm amber eyes, a subtle vertebra-like ridge along the back, and one small physical media token held close like a treasured catalog item. Clever, patient, quietly determined, slightly whimsical. No logos or text.
